overview.about: The Travelers Championship is a PGA Tour signature event played at TPC River Highlands in Connecticut, one of the best-attended stops of the season. A relatively short but strategic course, it produces low scores and grandstand-packed finishes on the closing holes.
overview.nextEvent: The next Travelers Championship is played at TPC River Highlands in Cromwell, Connecticut. As a signature event it brings a small elite field and a large purse to one of the Tour's most popular tournaments.

airportTransfer: Confirm the tournament's current transport guidance for TPC River Highlands before booking an airport transfer.

flightTip: Check the course access plan for TPC River Highlands; airport and road times are not interchangeable on tournament days.
stayGuidance: A base in Cromwell, Connecticut keeps everyday services nearby; check the last leg to TPC River Highlands before reserving accommodation.
bookingAdvice: Compare total price, cancellation terms and the route to the course before committing to tournament-week travel.
